name: Sansteel MinGuang Co.,Ltd.,Fujian
summary: Sansteel MinGuang Co.,Ltd.,Fujian manufactures and sells steel and its rolled products in China. The company offers building materials, metal products, round steel for machinery manufacturing, medium and heavy plates, H-beams, grinding steel balls, and coal chemical products, including coal tar, ammonium sulfate, and crude benzene, etc. The company serves metallurgy, mining, cement, and chemical raw materials and fertilizers industries. Sansteel MinGuang Co.,Ltd.,Fujian was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Sanming, China.
